::: {.notes}
Moonshot credits Kimi K3 with designing and implementing the compiler stack. Its repository contains the compiler and the example shown here. The block is an exact excerpt of vecadd, after offs is calculated. The test uses seed 0 and checks max absolute error below 1e-6. That is the acceptance threshold in the source, not a newly measured error. The separate benchmark scores at left were reported by the Kimi team.

[Moonshot · examples/vecadd.py](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/minitriton/blob/a4c5aa0ad6c18605b1c0e933431a3a27d736fe79/examples/vecadd.py). [Moonshot · GPU Compiler Development](https://www.kimi.com/en/blog/kimi-k3).
:::
